user_impact: Multibyte Unicode characters (emojis/Asian characters) split across 131072 chunk boundaries cause JSON syntax errors upon reassembly.
required_action: Implement code-point boundary aware chunking using Array.from() or surrogate pair offset adjustments.
acceptance_criterion: Reassembled JSON containing multibyte characters across chunk boundaries parses cleanly without replacement characters.

user_impact: Users with valid runId can access chunk records across project access boundaries.
required_action: Validate that runId belongs to the requested projectId and authorized session in getGraphChunks SOQL query.
acceptance_criterion: getGraphChunks throws AuraHandledException if runId does not belong to authorized projectId.

finding: Missing Schema Invariant Validation in Loader
user_impact: Structurally invalid JSON (e.g. primitive values or empty objects without nodes/edges) passes validation.
required_action: Update validatePayloadIntegrity to verify presence of required schema fields (nodes and edges arrays).
acceptance_criterion: validatePayloadIntegrity returns false for JSON objects missing required graph structure.

user_impact: Complex force-directed orbit dynamic physics and multi-pass Sankey crossing minimization are simplified.
